title: Bali Family Escape with Mount Batur Jeep
alt: Jeep on the lava field below Mount Batur, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Bedugul
stops.subtitle: Bedugul to Mount Batur
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Hill resort beside the Handara gate, cool evenings and a golf course

activities.name: Mount Batur sunrise by jeep
activities.match: Sunrise At Mount Batur by Jeep
activities.description: A four wheel drive up the volcano in the dark for sunrise on the black lava field, easy enough for children who cannot trek.

activities.name: Balinese massage
activities.description: An hour of traditional Balinese massage at the resort spa after the early start, warm oil and long pressure strokes.

program.name: Bedugul
program.description: Two nights up in the hills beside the Handara gate, with a jeep sunrise on Mount Batur and a spa hour afterwards.

stops.name: Seminyak
stops.subtitle: Seminyak to Nusa Penida and Uluwatu
stops.hotel: Bali Prime Villa by Kanaya Hospitality
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 2★ · Private pool villa a short ride from Seminyak beach

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan and a hill waterfall, finishing at the sea temple of Tanah Lot for sunset.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and the Paluang cliff viewpoint above the water.

activities.name: Snorkelling off Nusa Penida
activities.description: Mask and fins in the clear water on the way back, with coral heads and reef fish close enough to the shore for beginners.

activities.name: Trans Studio theme park
activities.description: Indoor rides, shows and a cinema in Denpasar, which is the easiest wet weather day in Bali with younger children.

activities.name: Uluwatu sunset with the Kecak dance
activities.description: The cliff top temple at Uluwatu as the sun drops, followed by the Kecak fire dance in the open amphitheatre above the sea.

program.name: Seminyak
program.description: Three nights in a private pool villa, with the Bedugul lakes on the way down, a Nusa Penida day with snorkelling and a theme park afternoon.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at the hill resort beside the Handara gate
Rest of the day free on the resort grounds
Optional: the strawberry farms and lake viewpoints nearby
2: Very early jeep ride up the lava slopes of Mount Batur
Sunrise over the caldera and the lake
Back at the resort for a late breakfast
An hour of Balinese massage at the resort spa
3: Breakfast and check out, then a full day in the lake country
The Handara gate and Ulun Danu Beratan temple
A hill waterfall, then sunset at Tanah Lot
Check in at your pool villa near Seminyak
4: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and the Paluang cliff
Snorkelling in the clear water before the boat back
5: Breakfast, then indoor rides at the Trans Studio park
Shows, the cinema and the arcade floor
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance in the amphitheatre afterwards
6: Breakfast at the villa and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: The jeep gets you to the Batur sunrise without the two hour climb. That is what makes this one work with children.
expert.tip: Bedugul is a thousand metres up and cold at dawn, so carry a fleece for everyone. The Handara gate photograph is free for resort guests, which saves you the queue outside.

summary: Six days for a family with two nights in a hill resort beside the Handara gate and three in a private pool villa near Seminyak, taking in a jeep sunrise on Mount Batur, Tanah Lot, Nusa Penida with snorkelling and the Kecak dance.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Mount Batur jeep sunrise; a Balinese massage; full day Bedugul tour with Tanah Lot; Nusa Penida west coast tour with snorkelling; Trans Studio tickets; Uluwatu sunset with the Kecak dance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
